programme.title: The Summer of 76!
programme.desc: The most famous heatwave of the century was in 1976 and these are the red-hot hits that soundtracked that summer. Including 'Dancing Queen', 'Jeans On', 'Devil Woman' and 'Combine Harvester'.

programme.title: Art of America
programme.desc: In Levittown, Andrew Graham-Dixon uncovers the dark side of post-war consumerism and the role artists have played in challenging the status quo. He visits New York's Metropolitan Museum to see the most subversive artwork of 1950s America, Jasper Johns's White Flag, examines Andy Warhol's soup can paintings and interviews one of the last surviving pop artists, James Rosenquist.

programme.title: One Foot in the Grave
programme.sub-title: In Luton Airport, No-One Can Hear You Scream
programme.desc: The Meldrews return from a disastrous Greek holiday to discover that their home has burnt down. Six months and a pile of insurance headaches later, they are ensconced in their new home and decide to throw a house-warming party. What could possibly go wrong?

programme.title: A History of Britain by Simon Schama
programme.desc: Simon Schama tackles the 20th century through the lives of two men, Winston Churchill and George Orwell. Both men, so very different in almost every way, lived through and wrote about the key moments of British 20th-century life: the Depression, Empire, two world wars and the Cold War. What unites them, argues Schama, is one shared theme - forget history at your peril.

programme.title: The American Revolution
programme.desc: Opposition in colonial North America to British policies over taxes, land and sovereignty escalates into violent confrontation; war gives 13 colonies a common cause.

programme.title: The American Revolution
programme.desc: Congress puts George Washington in command of a new Continental Army; Congress declares American independence in July 1776.

programme.title: Heatwave
programme.desc: An alarming vision of Britain caught in the grip of an environmental and social nightmare. It is summer 2006, and temperatures have topped 100 degrees, with no end in sight.

programme.title: Stonehenge: The Lost Circle Revealed
programme.desc: Professor Alice Roberts follows a decade-long historical quest to reveal a hidden secret of the famous bluestones of Stonehenge. Using cutting-edge research, a dedicated team of archaeologists led by Prof Mike Parker Pearson have painstaking compiled evidence to fill in a 400-year gap in knowledge of the bluestones, and to show that the original stones of Britain's most iconic monument had a previous life.

programme.title: Universe
programme.sub-title: Alien Worlds: The Search for Second Earth
programme.desc: Humans have long gazed up at the night sky, wondering whether other lifeforms and intelligences could be thriving on worlds far beyond our own. Answering that question seemed fated to remain pure speculation.

programme.desc: We reveal the extraordinary popularity of both Hitler and the Nazis, as well as the astonishing degree of voluntary support ordinary Germans gave the infamous Gestapo.

programme.title: One Foot in Arthur's Seat
programme.desc: Actor Ian Richardson walks up the hill to Arthur's Seat, which overlooks the city of Edinburgh, as he did during lunch hours as a bored office clerk 50 years ago.

programme.title: Remembers...
programme.sub-title: W Stephen Gilbert Remembers... Only Connect
programme.desc: W Stephen Gilbert looks back on the 1979 BBC drama 'Only Connect', portraying a homosexual relationship - including the challenges of making it and its impact since the original broadcast.

programme.title: The Other Side
programme.desc: Young academic Graham visits the elderly John Bury to learn more about pioneering socialist and gay rights campaigner Edward Carpenter for his thesis on the early UK Labour movement. Graham wants the facts but discovers, to his advantage, that people are not text books.

programme.title: Alison Steadman Remembers... Girl
programme.desc: National treasure Alison Steadman tells the story of one of the most groundbreaking and yet also most overlooked moments in British television. Despite the popular perception that Channel 4's Brookside broadcast TV's first lesbian kiss in 1994, in reality it was Alison and Myra Frances who first broke the taboo, 20 years earlier in the 1974 drama Girl.

programme.title: Second City Firsts
programme.desc: Just as she is about to leave the army, Jackie has an encounter with an old lover. Stars Alison Steadman in an early TV role.

programme.title: Vienna: Empire, Dynasty and Dream
programme.desc: Simon Sebag Montefiore tells the story of Vienna triumphant, after the Ottoman threat receded at the end of the 17th century. The city was rebuilt. No longer an outpost defending the West from Islamic invaders, the Habsburgs vowed their empire and imperial capital would become the most glittering in the world. The Habsburg emperors transformed the city from a fortress into a great cultural capital.

programme.title: Horizon
programme.sub-title: Tim Peake Special: How to Be an Astronaut
programme.desc: In December 2015, Tim Peake became Britain's first astronaut on board the International Space Station. For two years, he had been filming a video diary for Horizon as he prepared to leave. From family life to the rigorous training, this is an intimate portrait and remarkable insight into the world of an astronaut.

programme.title: The Magnificent Seven
programme.desc: A Mexican village is at the mercy of Calvera, the leader of a band of outlaws. The townspeople, too afraid to fight for themselves, hire seven American gunslingers to free them from the bandits' raids. The professional gunmen train the villagers to defend themselves, then plan a trap for the evil Calvera.

programme.desc: Bringing the best in television.

programme.title: Yr Whws
programme.desc: Wynona the puffin, Iggy the wolfhound, Scotty the highland bull and Ellie the hare wonder at the natural world all around them on Wise Island.

programme.title: Shwshaswyn
programme.desc: A stream is running from the rock-pool to the sea, but what is in it? A chance for the captain to go sailing, for Fflwff to rustle with the grass and for Seren to find an interesting piece of old rope.

programme.title: Jen A Jim Pob Dim
programme.desc: There are some strange goings-on in the garden. The leaves on the trees have changed colour and some of the animals have disappeared. Where have they gone?

programme.title: Tomos a'i Ffrindiau
programme.desc: Mae Nia yn cynllunio parti mawr i ddathlu pen-blwydd ei chyrhaeddiad i Sodor. Nia is planning a big party to celebrate the anniversary of her arrival on Sodor.

programme.title: Fferm Fach
programme.desc: Mae Leisa a Betsan yn mynd ar antur i ddarganfod sut mae selsig yn cael eu gwneud gyda Hywel y ffermwr hud. Leisa and Betsan go on an adventure to find out how sausages are made with Hywel the magic farmer.

programme.title: Blociau Lliw
programme.desc: Mae'r Blociau Lliw yn dod at ei gilydd. Faint ohonyn nhw ydych chi'n eu cofio? All the Colourblocks come together. How many of them are there, it's a real memory test!

programme.title: Digbi Draig
programme.desc: Mae Glenys yn penderfynu dychryn Betsi o'i Bwthyn Madarch fel ei bod hi a Teifion yn gallu byw yno yn ei lle. Glenys decides to frighten Betsi out of Mushroom Cottage so she can live there.

programme.title: Caru Canu a Stori
programme.sub-title: Mae Gen i Dipyn o Dy Bach Twt
programme.desc: Dod o hyd i gartref newydd yw bwriad Lliwen a Lleu y llygod, ond pan mae gwyntoedd mawr yn bygwth sbwylio pethau daw eu ffrindiau i'w helpu. Lliwen and Lleu the mice need to find a new home, and their friends come to help out.

programme.title: Twm Twrch
programme.desc: Beth sy'n digwydd ym myd Twm Twrch heddiw? What's happening in Twm Twrch's world today?

programme.title: Help Llaw
programme.desc: Mae Youssef yn galw Harri i ddweud fod sinc wedi torri yn y Cwtsh Newydd, Rhydaman. Mae Harri'n gneud dipyn o lanast yno! Youssef calls Harri to say that a sink has broken in Cwtsh Newydd!

programme.title: Byd Carlo Bach
programme.desc: What would you do if you were in space like Carlo?

programme.title: Caban Banana Gareth yr Orangutan
programme.desc: Mae Gareth yr Orangutan yn teithio ysgolion Cymru yn trafod amryw bynciau. Wythnos yma, Teulu ydi'r pwnc trafod. Gareth the Orangutan is back, and family is the topic of discussion.

programme.title: Byd Tad-cu
programme.desc: Mae Owen yn gofyn 'Pam fod gwenyn yn gwneud mêl?' Wrth gwrs, mae gan Tad-cu ateb dwl a doniol am yr adeg hynny pan stopiodd y byd droi! Owen asks: "Why do bees make honey?" and Tad-cu has a funny answer about the time when the world stopped turning.

programme.title: Ahoi!
programme.desc: A fydd y criw o forladron Ysgol Cwmbran yn llwyddo i helpu Ben Dant a Cadi i drechu Capten Cnec a chipio'r ynys nôl? Will the pirates from Ysgol Cwmbran succeed in helping Ben Dant and Cadi?

programme.title: Chwedlau Tinga Tinga
programme.sub-title: Pam Fod Cragen Crwban Yn Ddarniog?
programme.desc: There was a time when Tortoise's shell was all shiny and smooth. One day Tortoise discovered the birds were having a feast in the heavens, and he tricked them into making him a pair of wings.

programme.title: Twt
programme.desc: Toot hopes to impress the admiral with all his hard work, but finds that he cannot do everything by himself. Soon enough he learns that sometimes it is better to ask for help.

programme.title: Jen a Jim a'r Cywiadur
programme.desc: Trip yn y llong danfor yng nghwmni Deian y Dolffin, Cyw a Llew yw antur heddiw. Deian the Dolphin, Cyw and Llew go off in a submarine.

programme.title: Blero Yn Mynd I Ocido
programme.desc: Mae ieir Ffermwr Ffred wedi dianc, mae'r plu yn gwneud i Llinos Llosgfynydd cosi. Mae angen help Blero. Farmer Ffred's chickens have escaped, their feathers make Llinos Llosgfynydd itch.

programme.title: Annibendod
programme.desc: Mae Anni a Cai'n penderfynu chwarae cuddio. Ond mae Cai a Bochau'n methu dod o hyd i Anni, ydy hi'n creu annibendod yn rhywle? Anni and Cai decide to play hide and seek, but there's chaos!

programme.title: Mari, Hari a'r Byd Tanddwr
programme.desc: Heddiw, mae dau archwiliwr tanddwr yn ymuno â Mari a Hari wrth iddyn nhw gyfarch Sali'r seren fôr â'i sawl fraich. Learn all about Mari and Hari's many-armed friend, Sally the starfish!

programme.title: Tomos a'i Ffrindiau
programme.desc: Mae Tomos yn teimlo'n gyffrous ar ôl iddo ddarganfod cloch fuwch ar ochr y traciau. Tomos feels excited after he discovers a cowbell on the side of the tracks.

programme.title: Awyr Iach
programme.desc: Heddiw: ymweld â Bywyd Gwyllt Glaslyn, mynd am dro i Gastell Dryslwyn, a hwyl mewn Ysgol Goedwig ger Caerfyrddin. Join Meleri and Huw as they go on all sorts of open air adventures.

programme.title: Guto Gwningen
programme.desc: Mae Guto Gwningen yn trio tynnu sylw Mr Cadno oddi wrth glyweliadau cerddorol blynyddol Mr Pysgotwr. Guto Gwningen must distract Mr Cadno from Mr Pysgotwr's annual recital auditions.

programme.title: Annibendod
programme.desc: Mae Cai ac Anni'n mynd i'r ardd, tra bod Dad a Gwyneth yn glanhau'r ty ble maen nhw am drio twba twym Bela. Cai and Anni head for the garden while Dad and Gwyneth clean the house.

programme.title: Pentre Papur Pop
programme.desc: Ar yr antur popwych heddiw mae Huwcyn yn trefnu parti sypreis i Mabli! All Huwcyn orffen y paratoi mewn amser? On today's adventure, Huwcyn is planning a special surprise party for Mabli!

programme.title: Howie Shorts
programme.desc: Tra'n chwarae yn yr eira yn y parc, mae Howie'n amharu ar lun ac mae e angen ymddiheirio! Howie gets in the way of a photo and has to make amends.

programme.title: Kim a Cêt a Twrch
programme.desc: Ymunwch â Kim a Cêt ar antur hudolus a chwareus sy'n llawn dawns a cherddoriaeth wrth iddyn nhw chwilio am Twrch yn y goedwig. Join Kim and Cêt on a magical and playful adventure.

programme.title: Mojo Swoptops
programme.desc: Mae awyren Preston mewn trafferth, mae Mojo ar ei ôl yn y top jet! Preston's stunt plane is in trouble, and Mojo's right on his tail in the jet top!

programme.title: Dal Dy Ddannedd
programme.desc: Timau o Ysgol Bro Eirwg sy'n ymuno â Pwdryn a Melys i chwarae llond trol o gemau lliwgar! Teams from Ysgol Bro Eirwg join Pwdryn and Melys to play a series of candyland themed games.

programme.title: Newyddion S4C a'r Tywydd
programme.desc: Newyddion a thywydd. Coverage of a wide range of news topics and weather with expert commentary and analysis by BBC Wales correspondents.

programme.title: Cymru, Dad a Fi
